title: 光子相位陣列
summary: 從陣列相位、遠場旁瓣與封裝校正拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate array phase, far-field sidelobes and package calibration, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 場與孔徑
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「場與孔徑」的模型與驗證，六項作業各自留存交付物。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units address Fields and aperture through six separately saved modeling and verification work packages.

steps.title: 陣列因子：模型與設計
steps.objective: 以「陣列因子」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for array factor, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「陣列因子」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for array factor, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。
steps.observationEn: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交陣列因子的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for array factor, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.

knowledge.title: 本單元物理機制
knowledge.text: 遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。
knowledge.textEn: Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。
knowledge.textEn: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: AF(θ)=Σan exp[i(nkd sinθ+φn)]；實際遠場另乘天線包絡。 均勻直線陣列、遠場、忽略互耦；不是眼安全或最大量距模型。
knowledge.textEn: AF(θ)=Σan exp[i(nkd sinθ+φn)]; actual far field also includes the element pattern. Uniform linear array in the far field, neglecting mutual coupling; not an eye-safety or maximum-range model.

quiz.question: 要審查「陣列因子」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing array factor?
options: 遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。
增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。
只要相加各天線強度就能算干涉主瓣。
optionsEn: Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe.
Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes.
Adding antenna intensities predicts the interference main lobe.
quiz.explanation: 遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。 比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。
quiz.explanationEn: Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe. Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.

steps.title: 陣列因子：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「陣列因子」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for array factor, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「遠場是各天線複數場相加，不能將強度直接相加來預測主瓣。」與錯誤假說「只要相加各天線強度就能算干涉主瓣。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Far fields sum complex antenna fields, not intensities, to form the main lobe." against the incorrect hypothesis "Adding antenna intensities predicts the interference main lobe."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。
steps.observationEn: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：只要相加各天線強度就能算干涉主瓣。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Adding antenna intensities predicts the interference main lobe. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交陣列因子的量測判別表：比較兩天線同相與反相遠場，維持相同總輸入功率。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for array factor: Compare in-phase and opposite-phase two-antenna far fields at equal input power. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

The adjacent phase-step magnitude is |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2; its sign sets left versus right under the chosen convention.

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。按算例檢查弧度與角度，並保持相位與觀察方向符號規約一致。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「鄰天線相位梯度與間距共同決定掃描方向。」與錯誤假說「增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設均勻陣列 d=λ/2，欲偏轉 θ=30°，在所定符號下相鄰相位增量幅值 |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2；符號決定左右方向。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Check radians and degrees in the example with a consistent phase/direction sign convention. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Adjacent phase gradient and spacing jointly set beam direction." against the incorrect hypothesis "Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume a uniform array with d=λ/2 and θ=30°. The adjacent phase-step magnitude is |Δφ|=2π(d/λ)sinθ=π/2; its sign sets left versus right under the chosen convention.
steps.observation: 按算例檢查弧度與角度，並保持相位與觀察方向符號規約一致。
steps.observationEn: Check radians and degrees in the example with a consistent phase/direction sign convention.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：增天線數必定消除間距造成的光柵瓣。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Adding antennas always removes spacing-induced grating lobes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交相位梯度的量測判別表：按算例檢查弧度與角度，並保持相位與觀察方向符號規約一致。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for phase gradient: Check radians and degrees in the example with a consistent phase/direction sign convention. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.
